title: Major Hollywood Merger Moves Forward After Legal Settlement
subtitle: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery reach a deal with US states, clearing a path for their $110 billion combination.

summary.en: Paramount has settled a major lawsuit with twelve US states, removing a significant legal barrier to its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. The agreement requires the company to meet strict film production quotas and invest more in domestic projects. Additionally, Paramount must create an editorial board to ensure independent reporting at CBS News and CNN. While the deal clears a path for the merger, some critics remain concerned about media consolidation and the effectiveness of these new safeguards. The settlement still requires final approval from a judge before the companies can officially combine.
summary.zh: 派拉蒙已與美國十二個州就一項重大訴訟達成和解，移除了其與華納兄弟探索價值一千一百億美元合併案中的重大法律障礙。該協議要求公司必須達到嚴格的電影製作配額，並增加對國內項目的投資。此外，派拉蒙必須成立一個編輯委員會，以確保哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網與美國有線電視新聞網的報導獨立性。儘管此交易為合併案掃除障礙，但部分批評者仍對媒體整合以及這些新防護措施的有效性感到擔憂。在公司正式合併前，該和解案仍需等待法官的最終批准。

paragraphs.en: A massive change is coming to the entertainment industry. Paramount has reached a settlement with twelve US states, clearing a major hurdle for its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. This deal, which still needs a judge’s final approval, resolves an antitrust lawsuit—a legal action taken by the government to prevent companies from becoming too powerful and hurting competition. By settling this case, Paramount has removed one of the last big obstacles to a merger that is set to change Hollywood forever.
paragraphs.zh: 娛樂產業即將迎來巨大的變革。派拉蒙（Paramount）已與美國十二個州達成和解，為其與華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）價值一千一百億美元的合併案掃除了一大障礙。這項交易目前仍需等待法官的最終批准，但已解決了一樁反托拉斯訴訟——即政府為防止企業勢力過大而損害市場競爭所採取的法律行動。透過達成此項和解，派拉蒙移除了這場將永久改變好萊塢（Hollywood）格局的合併案中，最後幾項重大阻礙之一。

paragraphs.en: Under the terms of the agreement, Paramount must meet several strict requirements. According to BBC Business, the studio is now required to produce at least 30 films every year. To ensure these movies are high quality, the agreement includes rules against using only automated, AI-generated content. California Attorney General Rob Bonta explained that officials wanted to guarantee the production of "real, robust movies" that create jobs and support the local economy. If the company fails to meet these goals, it could face financial penalties or be forced to sell parts of its business.
paragraphs.zh: 根據協議條款，派拉蒙必須滿足幾項嚴格要求。據英國廣播公司商業新聞（BBC Business）報導，該製片廠現在每年至少須製作三十部電影。為了確保這些電影的品質，協議中納入了禁止僅使用自動化人工智慧生成內容的規定。加州檢察長羅伯·邦塔（Rob Bonta）解釋說，官員們希望確保製作出能創造就業機會並支持在地經濟的「真實且紮實的電影」。若該公司未能達成這些目標，可能面臨財務罰款，或被迫出售部分業務。

paragraphs.en: One of the most discussed parts of the settlement is the creation of a new "news editorial independence board." This board will oversee CBS News and CNN, which is owned by Warner Bros. Discovery. The goal is to ensure that reporting remains independent, objective, and based on facts. According to the settlement, the board must be created within 180 days of the merger. It will consist of five experienced journalists who will help resolve any disputes regarding reporting fairness or bias. NPR reports that an auditor will monitor the company to ensure it follows these rules, and the states have the power to return to court if Paramount fails to comply.
paragraphs.zh: 和解案中最受討論的部分之一，是成立一個新的「新聞編輯獨立委員會」。該委員會將監督哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網（CBS News）以及隸屬於華納兄弟探索的美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）。其目標是確保報導內容保持獨立、客觀且基於事實。根據和解協議，該委員會必須在合併後一百八十天內成立。它將由五位經驗豐富的記者組成，負責協助解決任何關於報導公平性或偏頗的爭議。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導指出，將有一位稽核員負責監控該公司以確保其遵守這些規則，若派拉蒙未能遵守，各州有權重回法院提告。

paragraphs.en: Paramount’s chair and chief executive, David Ellison, welcomed the agreement. He stated that the company is committed to serving consumers, workers, and the creative community. In an effort to address concerns about political influence, Ellison has promised that journalists at the combined company will answer to the facts rather than any political party or cause. This is a sensitive topic, as CNN and other news organizations are currently involved in a separate lawsuit against the Trump administration regarding access to the White House.
paragraphs.zh: 派拉蒙董事長兼執行長大衛·艾利森（David Ellison）對此協議表示歡迎。他聲明公司致力於服務消費者、員工以及創意社群。為了回應外界對於政治影響力的擔憂，艾利森承諾合併後公司的記者將以事實為依歸，而非聽命於任何政黨或立場。這是一個敏感議題，因為美國有線電視新聞網與其他新聞機構目前正因白宮採訪權問題，與川普（Donald Trump）政府進行另一場訴訟。

paragraphs.en: Despite the settlement, the merger continues to face criticism. The Writers Guild of America (WGA) expressed that it still believes the deal will harm writers and the industry. Although the WGA settled its own lawsuit—partly because it could not afford to fight the merger alone—the group remains unhappy with the outcome. As part of the deal with the WGA, Paramount has agreed to pay $17.5 million into the guild’s health fund and promised not to lay off writers at CBS News Broadcast for five years.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管達成和解，這項合併案仍面臨批評。美國編劇工會（WGA）表示，他們仍認為此交易將損害編劇權益與產業發展。雖然編劇工會解決了自身的訴訟——部分原因是無力獨自對抗這項合併案——但該組織對結果仍不滿意。作為與編劇工會協議的一部分，派拉蒙同意向工會的健康基金支付一千七百五十萬美元，並承諾五年內不會裁減哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網的編劇。

paragraphs.en: Other officials are also skeptical. NPR reports that Connecticut Attorney General William Tong was "deeply disappointed" that the settlement did not go further. He had pushed for the full sale of CNN and CBS News to prevent the new company from having too much control over the news media. Some experts worry that the settlement does not do enough to address the broader problem of media consolidation, where a small number of companies own almost all major news and entertainment outlets.
paragraphs.zh: 其他官員也持懷疑態度。美國國家公共廣播電台報導稱，康乃狄克州檢察長威廉·湯（William Tong）對於和解案未能更進一步感到「深感失望」。他曾推動全面出售美國有線電視新聞網與哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網，以防止新公司對新聞媒體擁有過大的控制權。部分專家擔心，此和解案並未充分解決媒體整合的廣泛問題，即少數幾家公司幾乎掌控了所有主要新聞與娛樂媒體的現象。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the merger represents a significant shift for legacy studios, major streaming services, and national news networks. While the settlement provides a path forward, the effectiveness of the new editorial board and the impact on the job market remain to be seen. For now, the industry is watching closely to see how these two media giants will integrate their operations. With the legal challenges mostly behind them, the companies are preparing to put their commitments into action, aiming to complete a deal that will reshape the landscape of American entertainment.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，這項合併案代表了傳統製片廠、大型串流服務平台與全國性新聞網的重大轉變。雖然和解案提供了一條前進的道路，但新成立的編輯委員會之成效以及對就業市場的影響仍有待觀察。目前，業界正密切關注這兩大媒體巨頭將如何整合其營運。隨著法律挑戰大多已成過去，這些公司正準備將承諾付諸行動，目標是完成這項將重塑美國娛樂版圖的交易。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「清理」或「清空」，這裡指排除障礙。文中：Paramount has reached a settlement with twelve US states, clearing a major hurdle for its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be responsible to someone or something; to be controlled by.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To strongly demand or work hard to achieve something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「推」，這裡指為了達成目標而施壓。文中：He had pushed for the full sale of CNN and CBS News to prevent the new company from having too much control over the news media.

keyTerms.definitionEn: It is not yet known or certain.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定用法，表示結果尚未揭曉。文中：While the settlement provides a path forward, the effectiveness of the new editorial board and the impact on the job market remain to be seen.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Paramount has reached a settlement with twelve US states to resolve a lawsuit blocking its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. The agreement requires Paramount to maintain specific levels of film production within the United States. It also includes protections for the independence of news organizations like CBS and CNN. While the company celebrates the deal as a step forward, some groups like the Writers Guild of America remain concerned about the impact on workers. The merger is expected to significantly change the landscape of the American entertainment industry.

quiz.question: What specific condition must Paramount meet regarding their film production to satisfy the settlement?

options.A: They must release at least 30 films annually, all of which must be written by human screenwriters.
options.B: They are required to produce a minimum of 30 films per year while avoiding total reliance on AI-generated content.
options.C: They must increase their annual film output to 30 movies to ensure that no AI tools are used in production.
options.D: They must guarantee that all 30 annual films are produced locally in California to support the economy.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，協議要求 Paramount 每年製作至少 30 部電影，且必須遵守「禁止僅使用自動化 AI 生成內容」的規則。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章僅提到避免完全依賴 AI，並未要求所有電影都必須由人類編劇；選項 C 錯誤，因為協議是限制 AI 的使用，而非完全禁止；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到加州檢察長希望電影能支持當地經濟，但並未強制要求所有電影都在加州製作。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the 'news editorial independence board' be considered a necessary compromise?

options.A: Because the government wants to directly control the political narratives reported by CNN and CBS.
options.B: Because the merger would otherwise give a single company too much power over major news outlets, risking bias.
options.C: Because the journalists at CNN and CBS have requested an external board to protect them from their own management.
options.D: Because the Trump administration demanded a board to oversee the fairness of news reporting during the merger.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段與第六段指出，媒體整合（media consolidation）導致少數公司掌控過多新聞媒體，引發外界對新聞獨立性的擔憂。設立該委員會是為了確保報導客觀、不受政治影響，藉此緩解大眾對於媒體過度集中的疑慮。選項 A 錯誤，政府目的是防止壟斷而非直接控制內容；選項 C 錯誤，文中未提到記者主動要求；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到 CNN 與川普政府的訴訟，但未說明該委員會是川普政府的要求。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'integrate' mean in the context of the two media giants?

options.A: To combine their separate systems and operations into a single, unified entity.
options.B: To force one company to adopt the exact policies and culture of the other.
options.C: To create a new, independent department that monitors the financial performance of both firms.
options.D: To sell off the smaller parts of the businesses to ensure they remain competitive.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在最後一段中，"integrate their operations" 指的是將兩家大型媒體公司的業務、系統與營運合併，使其成為一個協調運作的整體。選項 B 錯誤，合併不代表強迫採用對方文化；選項 C 錯誤，整合是指營運上的結合，而非建立監控部門；選項 D 錯誤，整合的目的是合併資源而非拆售業務。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery have successfully completed their merger after settling all legal disputes.
options.B: The entertainment industry is facing a crisis due to the rise of AI-generated content and political influence.
options.C: A significant media merger is moving forward under strict regulatory conditions despite ongoing criticism and skepticism.
options.D: The Writers Guild of America has successfully stopped the merger by forcing Paramount to pay into their health fund.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於報導 Paramount 與 Warner Bros. Discovery 的合併案，雖然透過和解解決了反壟斷訴訟，但仍面臨嚴格的監管條款（如電影產量限制、新聞獨立委員會）以及來自工會與官員的持續質疑。選項 A 錯誤，合併尚未最終完成；選項 B 過於偏頗，僅提到部分細節；選項 D 錯誤，WGA 並未阻止合併，僅是達成了一項協議。
